data.name: Mental Grit
data.description: You learn how to turn your psionic power into grit points.  As a swift action, you can spend 3 power points and expend your psionic focus after making a successful ranged attack with a firearm to gain 1 grit point, although you cannot exceed your normal maximum grit points.
